title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Restore Cushion and Energy Assistance Pledges: Decision Table
content:
An energy assistance pledge recorded on the underlying service account in its Electric Service by Rate Schedule records, by agency and pledge date, shapes the restore cushion of a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) restore payment.

**Rule.** Where an energy assistance pledge from LIHEAP or county emergency assistance was recorded on the underlying service account in the one-month window, the restore cushion is waived, because the agency's committed payment carries the enrollment; where no such pledge was recorded but one from the Salvation Army or Operation Round Up was, the restore cushion covers only the fixed charges, the cushion days multiplied by the tier's daily facility charge, rounded to the cent, because the grant will meet the usage; with no pledge in that window the pledge record does not change the restore cushion.

A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

**Daily facility charge by tier.** 1.07 on PrePay Power Residential, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 and PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40; 1.27 on PrePay Power Seasonal; 1.38 on PrePay Power Outbuilding and PrePay Power Small Commercial.

| LIHEAP or county emergency assistance pledge in the window | Salvation Army or Operation Round Up pledge in the window | Restore cushion |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | waived (0.00) |
| no | yes | cushion days multiplied by the tier's daily facility charge, to the cent |
| no | no | unchanged by the pledge record |

Hypothetical case: an Operation Round Up pledge last week on a PrePay Power Seasonal account with 6 cushion days gives a restore cushion of 6 multiplied by 1.27, which is 7.62. Had a LIHEAP pledge also been recorded in the window, the cushion would be waived.
